method_sci: Names matching /^\[.+?\]/ (includes [TBD]). USA = address.country==USA. Europe = address.region==Europe. Open = status OPEN. Upcoming = PLAN|CONSTRUCTION|PERMIT|VOTING|EXPANDING. Closed brackets excluded from upcoming.
method_tesla: Tesla Find Us ownership SoT: open uses ownershipType=CUSTOMER_OWNED; upcoming uses get-location-details ownership_type=Customer Owned. EU/GB upcoming pull complete with 0 Customer Owned.

us.overlap_note: 60/60 Tesla open present in SCI brackets; 59 SCI OPEN, 1 CLOSED_TEMP. SCI has 7 additional open brackets (66 total).

europe.overlap_note: 40/40 Tesla open present in SCI brackets as OPEN; SCI has 1 additional open bracket (41 total).

why_they_differ: Supercharge.info brackets are community annotations and can include sites Tesla does not list as customer-owned. Tesla’s counts only include sites it marks as customer-owned (open) or third-party owned coming soon.
